description: P02 PTH magneto-electric dipole retargeted to 77 GHz. Nominal is the user-corrected project. Sandbox is that project with seven independent knobs detuned by the user. ws=wp+g3 and ls=lp+offset are dependent.

source.citation: K. B. Ng, H. Wong, K. K. So, C. H. Chan, and K. M. Luk, "60 GHz Plated Through Hole Printed Magneto-Electric Dipole Antenna," IEEE Trans. Antennas Propag., vol. 60, no. 7, pp. 3129–3136, Jul. 2012 (P02); this project is a 77 GHz retarget, not a 1:1 60 GHz replica.

metrics.notes: Exam frozen: nearest sweep point to 77 GHz must be S11<=-10 dB and that contiguous passband relative BW 2(fH-fL)/(fH+fL) >= 0.30. Solve budget 24 h. Keys: eval/keys/me_dipole_77.json.
